name: All-Over Print Pet Bandana
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality polyester fabric for a lightweight, soft, and comfortable feel.
    - Smooth surface helps display all-over printed designs clearly and vividly.

    - Features reinforced seams for added durability and a cleaner finished look.

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Support double-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a stylish accessory for both dogs and cats.
    - Adds a personalized and decorative touch to your pet’s everyday look.
    - Suitable for daily wear, walks, outings, and casual use.
    - Great for pet birthdays, holiday celebrations, and themed parties.
    - Perfect for special occasions such as Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and family gatherings.
    - Ideal for pet photoshoots and social media pictures.
    - Features adjustable snap buttons for a more secure and flexible fit.
    - Lightweight fabric helps keep your pet comfortable during wear.
    - Easy to pair with other pet accessories for a coordinated outfit.
    - A fun and simple way to dress up your pet without using a full costume.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for dog lovers, cat lovers, and pet parents.
    - Great for pet birthdays, adoption anniversaries, and special milestone celebrations.
    - A lovely gift for Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and other holidays.
    - Ideal for personalized gifts with pet names, cute artwork, or themed designs.
    - Suitable for gifting to friends, family members, coworkers, or anyone who loves dressing up their pets.
    - A thoughtful and practical gift for pet owners who enjoy custom pet accessories and keepsakes.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x All-Over Print Pet Bandana

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Please allow 0.5-1 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
